answer: At each wharf of the network a recruiter posts a signed pledge that any new agent must echo back with a unique cryptographic plume derived from the recruiter’s key and a fresh nonce. The system verifies the plume; only if the echo matches does it grant a zero‑value referral reward, preventing the recruiter from profiting from mass‑generated identities. An attacker must therefore spend full registration fees for every fake node, making a Sybil burst economically prohibitive.
